title: New! 1 mi to Downtown - Music City Retreat - 4BR
description:
Nashville Townhome – Sleeps 12 | Minutes to Broadway

Spacious  4BR/2.5-bath East Nash townhome just minutes from downtown, Broadway, and Nissan Stadium. Perfect for families, large groups & getaways, it sleeps up to 12.
(Can be booked with a neighboring unit to double your space!)

Fully equipped kitchen 
55" smart TV with high-speed Wi-Fi
In-unit laundry & board games
Outdoor patio & parking

Walk or take a quick Uber to Nashville's top restaurants, live music, and nightlife.

The space
Home Layout & Amenities

Main Level

*Living Area:Relax on the queen sleeper sofa or loveseat while watching the 55" smart TV with YouTube TV.

Dining: Enjoy meals at the 4-seat dining table or pull up one of the 4 barstools at the kitchen counter.

Kitchen:Fully equipped with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, cookware, dishware, silverware, a Keurig (with pods), 2-slice toaster, electric wine opener, and filtered water.

Extras:Convenient half bath, a bedroom with a twin bed, and a back patio with seating.

Parking: Parking up to 6 vehicles (1 off-street)

### **Upper Level**

* **Bedrooms & Baths:** Four comfortable bedrooms and two full bathrooms plus half bath
* **Laundry:** Dedicated laundry room stocked with all essentials.

Guest access
Guests will have full access to the entire home with the exception of locked owner's closet.

Other things to note
Early Check-Ins & Late Check-Outs

🔹 Must Be Pre-Arranged – Requests for early check-ins or late check-outs must be made in advance. We cannot accommodate same-day or last-minute requests due to our cleaners' schedules.

🔹 Guaranteed Early Check-In/Late Check-Out – If the night before or after your stay is available, we can block it off for you at HALF the nightly rate to guarantee early access or a late departure.

Your Stay
🏡 Entire Home – You’ll have the place all to yourself for the ultimate home-away-from-home experience!

🚗 Parking – One designated spot off-street + street parking available.

🚖 Getting Around – Uber/Lyft rides average $10 to most places in Nashville!

✨ Book with confidence and enjoy your stay! ✨
